mapper.select: SELECT role_key, role_name, built_in, sort_order, created_at, updated_at FROM system_role ORDER BY sort_order ASC, role_key ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO system_role (role_key, role_name, built_in, sort_order) VALUES (#{roleKey}, #{roleName}, #{builtIn}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE system_role SET role_name = #{roleName}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE role_key = #{roleKey}
